prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a warm bronze-brown complexion, mid 30s goddess, towering hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily tall and curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a towering frame with legs that seem endless, thick smooth thighs and calves, hips wide and rounded, a sharply cinched narrow waist pulled in far tighter than her bust and hips, and a full heavy bust high on her chest; her height and long legs make every curve look longer and more dramatic; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, sculpted updo teal hair — wearing a skin-tight micro school uniform set, a cropped long-sleeve button-style shirt of ultra-thin matte crisp white modal jersey with the collar and neckline slipped low off both shoulders so that her shoulders and collarbones are bare, a loose red ribbon tie hanging at her chest, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to the cropped hem and the two sides of the modal jersey fully covering her bust, ending right under her bust with her whole midriff and stomach bare, and a micro pleated skirt of red tartan plaid modal jersey sitting at the top of her hip bones with the hem ending just below her hip bones. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small mole near her collarbone and a small beauty mark near her lips. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin modal jersey molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the shirt slipping off her shoulders, the loose red ribbon and the crisp tartan pleats, fine stretch lines and a soft powdery matte finish. Pose: crouching low on the balls of her feet with her knees together and angled to one side, one hand planted on the ground and the other arm resting on her thigh, face toward the camera, chin lifted, her legs fully in view — most extreme towering hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of glossy red leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in red lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large hoop earrings of polished gold with blackened iron accents as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Polynesian woman with a broad face, full lips and large dark eyes, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: slender upswept willow-leaf brows, a fine red floral huadian mark painted on the forehead, softly flushed rosy cheeks, an upswept eyeliner tail, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a small vivid red lip.

Background: a real industrial harbor city photographed as a real city at true scale, real streets, real skyscrapers and real buildings, container terminals with tall cranes, container ships, piers and warehouses, cars and buses on the roads and people on the sidewalks at their real size appearing as small as ants around her ankles, she is a colossal giant whose body is so large that the tallest buildings reach only to her knees, her towering heels planted between the real buildings on the piers and the quays, a warm orange sunset sky behind her, the whole real city clearly visible and in focus, lit by warm golden sunset light with gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the real buildings, cars and trees around her ankles shown at their true size so her colossal height and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
